run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/checkout since 2026-11-14T18:19:05Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/checkout is backed by a real, still-ongoing error signal: otel-demo checkout's oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder server spans carry STATUS_CODE_ERROR with rpc.grpc.status_code=13, and the trace-derived PlaceOrder error ratio rose from 0 at 18:19:05 to ~0.35-0.44 by ~18:26 and was ~0.27 at the end of the window, matching the alert's reported 0.2. The exact error text on those spans is 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400'. In the sampled failing traces the failing child call is checkout's HTTP POST whose only visible child is the shipping service's /get-quote server span (28-44 us), with no quote-service span under it; in a successful trace the same prepare step instead shows GetCart + CurrencyService/Convert + ProductCatalogService/GetProduct followed by a 1959 us /get-quote that does call shipping's 'POST quote' -> quote 'POST /getquote'. The failing prepare spans contain only CartService/GetCart, and per-order span counts (GetProduct 3118 vs 2022 successful PlaceOrders, Convert 5139, charge 2021) match only the successful orders, which supports (but does not prove) that the failing PlaceOrders had zero cart items and the shipping quote endpoint answered 400 without logging its usual 'Requesting quote'/'Sending Quote' and without calling the quote service. Checkout itself, the shipping pod, the quote service, payment, cart, currency and product-catalog show no error status of their own and no pod restarts; frontend 500s and load-generator 500s are propagation of the same PlaceOrder failure. A second, simultaneous failure mode exists in frontend-proxy (ingress 503s at ~22/s from ~18:21, router egress with http.status_code 0) whose cause is not established and which is not shown to cause the checkout errors. The literal 'email service' wording does not match the visible call topology and remains unresolved.

claims.text: otel-demo checkout's oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans carry STATUS_CODE_ERROR 866.0 times and its 'HTTP POST' client spans carry STATUS_CODE_ERROR 866.0 times in the window, while the same operations also have STATUS_CODE_UNSET counts of 2022.1 and 6064.2; no other checkout operation shows an error status.

The PlaceOrder error ratio (error span rate / all PlaceOrder span rate) was 0 at 18:19:05, 0.033 at 18:20:05, 0.199 at 18:23:05, 0.40 at 18:24:05, peaked near 0.444 around 18:30 and was still 0.266 at 18:58:05; the first non-zero 5-minute ratio reading was 0.04 at 18:20:05.

The error text recorded on checkout PlaceOrder spans (and on the frontend spans that received the gRPC error) is exactly 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400', with rpc.grpc.status_code=13 (INTERNAL); frontend records the same string as '13 INTERNAL: shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400'.

In the sampled failing traces the failing span is checkout's 'HTTP POST' client span (382 us, error=true) whose child reference resolves to shipping's '/get-quote' server span of 44 us, and no shipping 'POST quote' or quote-service span appears in those traces; the four sampled failing traces all show shipping /get-quote at 28-44 us with no status tags.

A successful checkout trace shows the same step working: prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart contains oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, two oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert spans and oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, followed by an 'HTTP POST' of 2383 us to shipping '/get-quote' (1959 us) which calls shipping 'POST quote' -> quote 'POST /getquote'; the same trace's other checkout HTTP POSTs are shipping '/ship-order' (370 us) and email 'POST /send_order_confirmation' (5284 us, http.status_code 200).

In the four sampled failing traces the prepare step contains only CartService/GetCart (and cart's HGET/POST spans), with no ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and no CurrencyService/Convert span at all.

Per-service span volumes are consistent with only the successful PlaceOrders doing item work: checkout oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 3118.3, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert 5139.4, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 2021.1 (UNSET only) versus 2022.1 successful and 866.0 failed PlaceOrder spans.

Shipping's own spans show no error status in the window: /get-quote 2884.6, POST quote 2019.4 and /ship-order 2019.9 spans are all STATUS_CODE_UNSET, and the quote service's POST /getquote 2019.9, calculate-quote 2019.9 and {closure} 2019.9 spans are all STATUS_CODE_UNSET, i.e. roughly one quote-service call per successful PlaceOrder and none for the failing ones.

The shipping pod logged 1895 'Requesting quote' lines and 1895 'Sending Quote' lines over 18:09-18:59 (log read through 18:54:00), i.e. fewer than its ~2885 /get-quote spans, and its log lines contain no error text; around the failing request at 18:18:53.46 the log shows no line at all (only 18:18:54.04 and later).
The quote service pod logs only successful 'Calculated quote' lines in the sampled window slice, with no error lines observed.

The email service shows 2013.8 'POST /send_order_confirmation', 2013.8 'send_email' and 4027.5 'sinatra.render_template' spans, all STATUS_CODE_UNSET, and the successful trace's email span carries http.status_code 200; no email error status series exists in the window.
Checkout's payment path is not erroring: oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge has 0 error increase and 2021.1 UNSET, and payment's own GET, dns.lookup and tcp.connect error increases are all 0.

No error status exists for cart (HGET/HMSET/EXPIRE/POST /oteldemo.CartService/*), currency (Currency/Convert STATUS_CODE_OK), product-catalog (GetProduct/ListProducts UNSET) or quote spans in the window.

All 21 otel-demo pods are Running and ready with restart count 0, including checkout-5dccddf8bb-vh65b, shipping-75d58f5d84-kgmz9, email-59f69bc6cf-7wqqk and quote-6b5877698d-x6v2f, which were all created 18:08:56-18:08:58; only load-generator was replaced during the window (new pod load-generator-7d5756fbd9-zzj4z created 18:43:11, old load-generator-c7cbc4c99-xlnk2 deleted 18:43:12).

The target addresses look consistent: checkout deployment env has SHIPPING_ADDR=http://shipping:8080 and EMAIL_ADDR=http://email:8080, shipping has QUOTE_ADDR=http://quote:8080, and the shipping, email and quote Services/Endpoints resolve to port 8080 with one endpoint each (shipping 100.96.3.37:8080, email 100.96.3.192:8080, quote 100.96.3.183:8080).

The checkout failures propagate to callers: frontend 'POST /api/checkout' has 864.2 error spans and 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' 864.2 error spans versus 866.0 checkout PlaceOrder errors, and the sampled failing traces show frontend http.status_code 500 at frontend, frontend-proxy ingress/router frontend egress and load-generator POST.

A separate, simultaneous frontend-proxy failure mode exists: frontend-proxy 'ingress' spans have 52805.3 STATUS_CODE_ERROR and 24642.1 STATUS_CODE_UNSET increases and 'router frontend egress' has 569.2 errors; sampled ingress errors are http.status_code 503 with the child 'router frontend egress' carrying error="true" and http.status_code 0, and that error rate went from 0 at 18:19:05 to ~8.5/s at 18:21:05 and ~22/s afterwards.

Current flagd configuration in configmap flagd-config sets every flag to defaultVariant 'off' except loadGeneratorFloodHomepage whose defaultVariant is '100'; this is the object's state at query time, not at incident time.

Primary cause of the alert: checkout's shipping-quote step fails because its HTTP POST to the shipping service's /get-quote returns HTTP 400 (the checkout error states 'expected 200, got 400'), producing gRPC 13 INTERNAL on PlaceOrder and the ~30% PlaceOrder error ratio; shipping answers those requests in 28-44 us without logging 'Requesting quote'/'Sending Quote' and without calling the quote service, which fits an early rejection (request validation/decoding) inside shipping rather than a slow or failing quote dependency.

The requests that trigger the 400 are PlaceOrders with an empty cart: in all four sampled failing traces the prepare step did no ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and no CurrencyService/Convert work (only GetCart), and at the aggregate level GetProduct (3118.3) and Convert (5139.4) counts correspond only to the 2022.1 successful PlaceOrders, not to the 866.0 failures. The exact shipping validation rule that turns that into a 400 could not be read.

The 'email service' wording in the error string is inconsistent with the observed call topology (the failing POST's child is shipping /get-quote; checkout's real email POST is a separate span under PlaceOrder) and may be a mislabeled error string in the checkout quote-shipping code path; it could not be resolved from telemetry alone, and the email service itself shows no error status and its recorded 2013.8 send_order_confirmation spans match the successful orders.

The large frontend-proxy ingress 503 volume (~22/s from ~18:21, router egress http.status_code 0) is a second, separate problem affecting proxied requests that never reached a healthy upstream; it is not shown to cause the checkout gRPC 13 INTERNAL failures, whose own error text and span chain point at the shipping quote call, so it remains a candidate for an independent incident rather than the cause of this alert.

The load-generator pod replacement at 18:43:11-18:43:12 (new ReplicaSet load-generator-7d5756fbd9 scaled up, old load-generator-c7cbc4c99 scaled down) is not the trigger of this incident: checkout PlaceOrder errors were already present from ~18:19:05 and reached 0.40 by 18:24:05, roughly 19 minutes before that rollout.

Pod- and runtime-level causes are not supported for this failure: all pods are Running/ready with 0 restarts (no Evicted/OOMKilled/BackOff visible), no pod was recreated at incident onset (checkout, shipping, email, quote all created 18:08:56-18:08:58), and payment, cart, currency, product-catalog, quote, shipping and email record no error status of their own.

Have the demo owners read the shipping service's /get-quote handler (request decoding/validation and where 'Requesting quote' is logged) to confirm why a subset of quote POSTs is rejected with HTTP 400 before any quote-service call, and check the load-generator's checkout flow for checkouts issued with an empty cart.

Fix the checkout error string so it names the service actually called (shipping), and consider mapping a client-side 400 from the quote endpoint to a non-INTERNAL status so a request-validation condition does not surface as an INTERNAL server error and an error-rate alert.

Investigate the frontend-proxy ingress 503 stream (router egress http.status_code 0) as a separate issue with its own alerting, since it is far larger in span volume than the checkout errors and its cause is not yet known.

gaps: The RequestErrorRate alerting rule itself could not be read: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name RequestErrorRate returned no rule (status no_data), so the alert's exact expression, its metric and lookback are unknown; the error ratio used here is derived from traces_span_metrics_calls_total on otel-demo checkout PlaceOrder spans.

No metric named http_server_request_duration_seconds_* exists in this source (get_metric_names returned no_data), so per-endpoint HTTP status codes for shipping/email could not be read directly; the 400 status is known only from the checkout span error text.
The email container produced zero log lines in 18:00-18:59, so the email service's request handling and any 400 responses cannot be confirmed from logs; email logs are unknown, not clean.

A traces_search_by_tags for service email with error=true and for http.status_code="400" in 18:15-18:45 returned no traces (no_data), which is unknown rather than proof that email never returned an error; Jaeger's retention appears to cover only about 18:17:54-18:23:55, so later failures up to 18:59 are not in the trace sample.

checkout container logs contain no matching error lines in 18:14-18:25 (filter runs returned no_data), so the failing PlaceOrder requests are not evidenced in checkout application logs; the reason shipping rejects them is not visible.

The request payload of the failing quote POST (e.g. item count) could not be read, so the 'empty cart' explanation for the 400 remains a hypothesis; the shipping handler's validation rule is not visible from telemetry and secrets cannot be read.

No change-history integration is available in this run, so configuration or flag changes before 18:19 (including any flagd flag state during the incident) cannot be checked; the flagd configmap read is the object's state at query time only.

Kubernetes objects and events are the cluster's state at query time; the only in-window events returned concern the load-generator rollout at 18:43:11-18:43:12, so earlier object changes cannot be ruled in or out.
next_steps: Read the shipping service source for the /get-quote handler and its request validation to confirm which condition yields HTTP 400 before the 'Requesting quote' log line and the quote-service call.
Inspect the load-generator checkout flow to determine whether it issues /api/checkout for users with an empty cart, and whether that is intended behavior that should be handled as a client error.
Review the frontend-proxy 503 stream separately (upstream connection failures with http.status_code 0 on router frontend egress) and its relation to the frontend replica's capacity.
Add alert-rule visibility (or export the RequestErrorRate rule) so future investigations can read its exact expression and thresholds.
Enable the change-history integration to correlate flagd flag flips and configuration changes with error-rate onsets.
